description: Create an Airflow DAG for logistics_co that refreshes the route_performance table using either a full rebuild or an incremental load. The DAG should use @task.branch to choose: full rebuild on the first day of each month or when the Airflow Variable route_perf_force_full is 'true'; otherwise incremental. Both branches converge on a shared 'update_statistics' task followed by 'notify'. After a forced full rebuild the Variable must be reset to 'false'. The DAG runs daily at 02:00 UTC.
edge_cases: The join task after the branch must not use the default all_success trigger rule, or it will always be skipped
Day-of-month check must use the logical date, not today's date, so that reruns of old dates choose the same branch
Variable must be read inside the task at runtime, not at DAG parse time
Variable reset must only happen on the forced-full path and only after the rebuild succeeds
common_failure_modes: FM6: Join task with default trigger_rule is skipped because one branch is always skipped
FM6: Variable.get at module top level evaluates on every scheduler parse and freezes the branch decision
FM2: Using datetime.now().day causes a rerun of the 1st to take the incremental path
